# SpinalLocomotorCPG

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking neural network model of the spinal central pattern generator (CPG) that generates rhythmic locomotor commands for coordinating limb movement. Provides a biologically plausible, neuromorphic-compatible substrate for real-time locomotion control in iNEST systems.
